hypothesis.known_by_rule: all four original publication-day labels strictly precede the current entry day
hypothesis.entry_calendar_rule: first exchange session strictly after current monthly publication-day label
hypothesis.prior_year_plan_rule: known before current decision; do not construct prior-year trades retroactively

account.entry_quantity: whole lots affordable at previous close plus declared slippage and commission, capped at 1000 CNY; do not increase at a cheaper fill
account.entry_attempt: once at next session raw close plus declared slippage; reject if planned fill notional exceeds position cap; cash may reduce whole lots
account.share_conversion_entry_day: skip because previous close uses old units
account.overlap_rule: skip any new event while shares are held at session start, including a full exit day
account.scheduled_exit: entry index plus 20 close-to-close transitions; sell all available shares, retry each later session if blocked
account.risk_response: any daily-loss, drawdown or marked-position breach permanently halts new entries; attempt full exit at next session close and retry until flat
account.terminal_rule: mark unresolved positions and receivables, report unqualified terminal state; never invent a final fill or extend the sample
account.dividend_cash_timing: receivable at ex-date, cash after pay-date close, per-entitlement half-up to cents
account.dividend_coverage_assumption: four reviewed gross notices and matched periodic totals; assume no unlisted conversion in retained 2020-2024H1 window, not source certification
account.missing_execution_flags: retain and disclose absence; conditional daily-close fills are not certified executable quotes

comparison.primary: selected-event account terminal PnL minus unconditional eligible-event account terminal PnL at minimum commission 5 CNY
comparison.absolute: selected-event terminal PnL versus zero-interest cash
comparison.unconditional_entries: same 43 eligible publication events, same fees, lot sizing, horizon, overlap and risk rules
comparison.formal_significance_test: none; reused exploratory window and incomplete search history preclude a formal positive-EV claim
comparison.annual_contributions: all calendar-year marked equity changes, including partial 2024, reported descriptively

primary_requires: at least 15 selected complete round trips
selected terminal holdings and receivables settled
decision.pass_means: conditional candidate merits separate source/execution and forward-paper review only
decision.failure_means: close this fixed hypothesis or document insufficient evidence; no sign flip, threshold/horizon tuning, larger position, cheaper fee selection or wider history rescue
